goal_text: (Reused from sequential_016) A clothing store marks up items 80% above cost price. During clearance, items are discounted 40% from the retail price. A worker buys 3 jackets at the clearance price. The original cost per jacket was $75. Compute: (1) retail price per jacket, (2) clearance sale price per jacket, (3) total paid for 3 jackets, (4) the store's profit or loss per jacket at the sale price.
ground_truth: Retail = 75*1.80 = $135; sale = 135*0.60 = $81; total 3 jackets = 3*81 = $243; profit per jacket = 81-75 = $6 (the store still makes $6 per jacket even at clearance)
